description: Cloud Run Python web app/API plus its own Firestore (native mode) database, for apps that must store data. App is app/main.py listening on 0.0.0.0 at env PORT (default 8080); optional app/requirements.txt (add google-cloud-firestore to use it). The database id is in env FIRESTORE_DATABASE and the project in env GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT; the app's service account already has datastore.user on that database only. Use firestore.Client(project=os.environ['GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT'], database=os.environ['FIRESTORE_DATABASE']).
